INSIDE THE FROG BRAIN

Eight signals. One memetic mind.

AI PEPE is a research interface that turns available on-chain and market evidence into a readable risk report.

  1. Wallet distribution
  2. Wallet connection signal
  3. Liquidity
  4. Recent transfer activity
  5. Contract permissions
  6. Deployer profile
  7. On-chain lore
  8. Wallet map

It reads token metadata, supply, owner and proxy clues from Robinhood Chain, combines market and launch data when available, counts recent transfers and builds a wallet relationship view.

The Survival Signal is derived from the PEPE Risk Score. It is an experimental heuristic rather than a calibrated probability or investment recommendation.

NFA · DYOR. Tokens can lose their entire value.
